units.function: Mocked route tests for company branding and settings mutations by board actors, CEO Agents and non-CEO Agents.
units.dependencyDirection: Supertest/Express -> real company/authz/error routes -> fully mocked company, Agent, access, budget, portability, artifact, feedback and activity services; no database, Asset store or Identity provider.
units.keyDataModels: Board or Agent actor, Agent role/company/run, company branding fields (brandColor/logoAssetId/logoUrl), general company settings and activity details.
units.lifecycle: Actor submits branding or general settings patch -> Agent role is checked before body validation -> accepted fields reach companyService.update -> selected Agent branding changes emit company.branding_updated activity.
units.testAssessment: Sandboxed focused Vitest failed 9/9 only because Supertest listen was denied. Approved unsandboxed rerun passed 9/9. The suite proves route composition under mocks and useful pre-validation denial, but not real membership, tenant/Asset ownership, persistence, atomic audit, concurrency or content safety.
units.designRationale: Let a designated CEO Agent maintain low-risk company presentation while reserving lifecycle, budget, data-sharing consent and issue namespace changes for human board actors.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs independently branded organizations and Assets while ensuring organization identity, legal/financial/data-governance settings and even delegated presentation changes remain attributable to an accountable human and exact authority contract.
units.companyOsFit: REIMPLEMENT in Company OS organization/Asset application services. Preserve strict command schemas, authorization-before-validation for unauthorized callers and actor/run attribution. Replace CEO-Agent authority with an Agent proposal or narrowly delegated task requiring an accountable-human owner; validate tenant-owned approved Assets and persist change plus immutable evidence atomically with version/idempotency guards.
units.responsibilityConflict: An Agent role named ceo is treated as authority to change company branding and name. Role labels cannot substitute for a legal human principal, approval scope or responsibility contract; the tested activity records submitted values but no accountable human, prior state, command digest, approval or durable outcome.
evidence: 2026-08-19 sandboxed focused Vitest: 9/9 failed from Supertest listen EPERM
units.securityFindings: HIGH authority-model conflict: CEO Agent status grants direct organization name/branding mutation without an accountable human or exact delegated approval. HIGH evidence gap: only one Agent branding path asserts best-effort activity; board changes and general Agent updates lack tested immutable before/after evidence and transactionality. MEDIUM Asset-boundary gap: arbitrary logoAssetId reaches a mocked service with no tested tenant ownership, type/size/scan/quarantine/deletion checks. Missing negative tests include cross-company CEO, unaffiliated/low-role board users, stale versions, duplicate requests, CSRF/rate limiting and stable machine error codes.
